target_customer: Hardware teams in robotics, EV, medical devices, aerospace and consumer hardware that need custom wire harnesses in low to mid volumes
problem: Custom wire harnesses normally take 5 to 7 weeks and need sales callbacks for quotes. Hardware teams lose schedule waiting on them.
business_model: Manufacturing service with instant online quoting, priced per order

founders.name: Lucas Crupi
education: Dropped out of university (school not named on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on battery design for the Cybertruck without naming the employer, and became a SolidWorks expert at 15.

founders.name: Ethan Breit
education: Dropped out of university (school not named on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built an embedded OS on his own at school and has programmed since age 8. The founders met at the Canada Wide Science Fair.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating wire harness assembly is a long unsolved robotics problem because wires are deformable and connectors vary (the site claims 500+ connector types and up to 700+ circuits). A small team also had to build AI reading of customer drawings and instant quoting.

defensibility.rationale: Factory automation know how and certified workmanship (IPC/WHMA-A-620 per the site) are hard to copy quickly, but the quoting front end is easy to imitate and many incumbents sell harnesses.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found in sources; only vendor pages from other shops advertising quick quotes.

market_need_then: The company's own site cites 5 to 7 week traditional lead times against its 7 day claim, and a customer testimonial says short lead times are a real unlock. No independent dated demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses loombotic.com; no purchase history found. Legal entity on the site is Fabraicate, Inc.

identity.logo: Bold orange logo per the website
identity.visual_style: Industrial, speed focused, anti black box message
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident, short punchy headlines about removing delay

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no press about the brand. The site has a consistent bold voice but the name sits close to Loom and the company legal name differs.

outcome_analysis: Loombotic is an active Fall 2024 YC company with 25 people on the YC page and a live ordering site. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news was found. Funding is unverified, so the trajectory beyond the batch cannot be judged from public sources yet.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators and unverified: Caplight lists a $500K round led by YC on 2024-09-29 and total seed funding of $1.5M dated 2024-10-01 with Theory Forge Ventures; Dealroom lists a $125K seed. These conflict, so no round is recorded. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found; a search surfaced Cableteque (software) and other shops but without dates near 2024-09. The YC Launch page for Fabricate describes a drawing product whose link to the harness business is unclear.
